description.title: EU_SUSTAg project header for a data4simplace export

projectdata.description:
WIKI_START === Purpose === The project header this pairs with EU_SUSTAg_data4simplace.sol.xml. None of Rotation_monocrop/project/*.proj.xml work as shipped: they still key on the old cluster's projectid/simulationid pair with no vColumn/vRow (so every cell would silently read the same weather file -- see the solution's own header comment) and no sowing column at all (so every cell sows on the solution's one hard-coded default day, defeating the rule-based sowing this run exists to test). cm4eu overwrites the interface's filename below at build time; only the header's column list is read (cropmodelling4eu.simplace.project.project_columns).
=== Data === Every column here is filled straight from the export via cropmodelling4eu.simplace.project._BUILDERS -- vColumn/vRow (the weather file's row/column), vLatitude, vAltitude, vSowWindowStartDOY/ vSowWindowLengthDays (the per-cell planting window; see CLAUDE.md's Planting Window section) and vIRRIGATION. No `constants` are needed: vCrop, vClimPerCO2_ID, vCO2, vCO2_level and vFertilizerScenario are left to the solution's own top-level var defaults (WW / C1 / 360 / elev / 2), which already match this export -- C1 is ClimPerCO2.csv's own ambient/no-scenario row (Period 0, gcm_rcp 0_0), correct for an observational MSWX run with no GCM/RCP axis, and every schedule row the export writes uses FertilizerScenario 2. vENZ (the SUSTAg EnS v8 environmental zone) has no data4simplace source, so it is also left to the solution's own default rather than written as a fabricated NA.
=== Usage === simplace.project_file: this file WIKI_END
